7610: Cortech Endurance Wall Mount ADA Desk with Laminate Top
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-7610-endurance-ada-compliant-wall-mounted-desk
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/endurance-wall-mount-ada-laminate-desk/
Spec sheet: 7610
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Endurance Wall Mount ADA Desk with Laminate Top – 7610
Current H1: Cortech Endurance Wall Mounted Desk ADA‑Compliant - One-Piece Rotationally Molded - Model 7610
Subtitle: One-Piece Molded ADA-Compliant Desk with a Laminate Top That Bolts to the Wall
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 7610 Endurance ADA Wall Mount Laminate Top Desk
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Endurance Wall Mount ADA Desk with Laminate Top gives people who use wheelchairs a fixed, accessible work surface in patient rooms, cells, and other secure settings. It meets all ADA requirements, with knee and toe space and clear floor space for a front approach.
The desk is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene and has a laminate top. It bolts to the wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice, and it must be mounted 6” to 8½” from the floor to be ADA compliant.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene with a laminate top; no steel components
ADA Compliance: Meets all ADA requirements, with knee and toe space and clear floor space for a front approach
Dimensions: 36”W×20”D×25½”H
Weight: 34 lbs
Mounting: Bolts to the wall through concealed pilot holes; must be mounted 6” to 8½” from the floor to be ADA compliant
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: 5-year warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
7610 – Laminate Top: 36”W×20”D×25½”H, 34 lbs
Installation and Options
Wall Mounting: Bolt to the wall through concealed pilot holes with hardware of your choice; mount the desk 6” to 8½” from the floor to meet ADA requirements
Pilot Holes: Cortech advises not to pre-drill pilot holes until the desk is on site and ready to install
[H2] Applications
The Wall Mount ADA Desk suits accessible rooms where a desk must stay fixed to the wall and leave clear space for a wheelchair.
Typical applications include:
Accessible cells and housing units in correctional facilities and jails
Accessible patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Residential treatment centers and other rooms that need an ADA-compliant desk
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Endurance Series
The Cortech Endurance Series is a line of heavy-duty molded furniture for behavioral healthcare facilities, correctional institutions, and other intense use environments. Endurance products are made for durability, easy cleaning, and safety-conscious design.
The Endurance Series includes:
Beds and Bunks: Endurance beds, wall-mounted bunks, and EZ Bunk stackable temporary sleep surfaces
Seating: Benches, cubes, and the Endurance ‘In Sync’ Modular Series chairs
Tables and Desks: Molded and laminate-top tables, freestanding desks, and wall-mounted desks, including ADA models
Storage: Lockers, nightstands, open chests, and shelving
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (55 characters): Cortech Endurance ADA Laminate Desk - 7610 at Anchortex
Meta description (156 characters): Shop the Cortech Endurance Wall Mount ADA Desk. A one-piece molded ADA-compliant desk with a laminate top that bolts to the wall in cells and patient rooms.
Notes and Questions
Series section: this is the same "About Cortech Endurance Series" section as on the EZ Bunk page.
H1: I took out "One-Piece Rotationally Molded" and "Model," and added "with Laminate Top," as Cortech calls it the Wall Mount ADA Laminate Desk.
Weight: your variant is set to 40 lbs. The Cortech spec sheet says 34 lbs, so I used 34 lbs.
Warranty: your current page says 10-year warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says 5-year warranty, so I used that.
Laminate finishes: the Cortech spec sheet refers to its color guide for laminate options but does not list them, so I did not list finishes.
Colors: your current page lists 12 colors. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18, so I used the Cortech list.
Product images: the page has five images, including a photo with a wheelchair. The last image is the older Cortech color chart. Cortech now lists 18 colors. Would you like it replaced?
